The club's colours are green, black and white, and their home is the [[Alphamega Stadium]]. Founded in 1930, Aris Limassol is one of the most historic football clubs of [[Limassol]]. The club also maintains teams in other sports including basketball, table tennis, darts, bowling and chess. The Aris chess team dominated Cypriot chess in the 1980s."}}
